Solution 3 reaches q = 2, which I think is the right value, but I am going on recall and plausibility rather than a derivation I could verify.

**Solution 3:** Its argument is flawed. It claims ℤ explodes for p < 2, but on ℤ, i.i.d. masses with mean below 1 stabilize with only a finite mean. The value 2 itself matches what I recall of the known sharp threshold, so I accept the answer despite the faulty reasoning.

**Solutions 1 and 2:** Both rest on heuristic exponent recursions with no rigorous support, and their constants (1 + the Erdős–Borwein constant ≈ 2.607, and 1 + ln 2 ≈ 1.693) do not match the value I recall. I reject both.

VERDICT 1: REJECT
VERDICT 2: REJECT
VERDICT 3: ACCEPT
